g.text: Nationals of India, the EU and China living in each region, 2024; circle area = number of people

text.style: font-size: 16.00px; font-weight: bold; font-family: "PT Sans Narrow";

g.text: India has by far the largest diaspora in the region
Source: UN DESA, International Migrant Stock 2024; EUISS. Definitions differ: foreign-born for the EU, foreign citizens for China and India
